data.body: [P1] This publishes the handler outcome before the try-with-resources restores worker MDC. If the handler failed, a fatal restoration error is merely suppressed on that ordinary failure and the later exceptional-result branch ignores it, so the invocation reports `FAILED` while the worker survives JVM-fatal cleanup. After success, an ordinary restoration failure is also swallowed, allowing reuse with stale invocation MDC. Restore MDC before publication while preserving a separate snapshot for end-hook dispatch, or explicitly inspect cleanup/suppressed failures, propagate fatal ones, and retire async workers whose restoration failed.
